item.title: 'Mass Effect Universe' Leak Promised What Fans Have Waited Decades For
item.description: If fans were already sad about BioWare closing down , they're shattered after watching the leaked trailer for Mass Effect Universe . Sure, the trailer was short and a little cheesy — but it could have also signaled a return to form for the stagnant franchise. And at the heart of every good Mass Effect game is a crew of characters that you get to know as the adventure unfolds.

item.title: Half-Life 3 Rumors Reignite After Valve Employee Lets Codename Slip
item.description: It's been two decades since we last checked in on Gordon Freeman in Half-Life 2: Episode Two , with the promise of a third Half-Life game languishing for an absurdly long time. In the intervening years, Valve has neither confirmed nor denied a third mainline Half-Life game, though the secretive studio is rumored to have canceled at least one attempt to make Half-Life 3 . Surprisingly, there's fresh evidence of a new Half-Life game directly from Valve, though the person revealing that information seemingly didn't intend to.

item.title: 'Clayface' Officially Sets Up Another Iconic Batman Villain in the DC Universe
item.description: Back in the summer of 2025, Clayface was filming in Liverpool. Photos from the set revealed a reference to another, far more famous Batman villain. One featured a wall with graffiti on it, and among the different tags was one that read “The Jokers.” That led to some speculation about Joker’s presence in the DC Universe ’s Gotham.

item.title: Everything We Know About the PS6, Sony’s Next-Gen Console
item.description: If it doesn’t feel like it’s time to start thinking about the PlayStation 6 yet, it’s because lengthening game development times have slowed the pace of new releases for PS5, because initial take-up of the console was slowed by supply issues, and because the COVID-19 pandemic distorted everyone’s sense of time. But the time is upon us all the same.

item.title: Everything We Know About Project Helix, the Next Xbox
item.description: The results have been chaotic: a leadership change, mass layoffs, the closure and divestment of several studios. Console exclusivity for first-party was seemingly abandoned, but is now (partially) back on the menu. Game Pass is in flux, with multiple changes in bundling and pricing strategy, and more on the way. Microsoft has finally solved the drought of first-party games that plagued it during the Xbox One era and the first years of the Xbox Series — but, ironically, it seems to have nowhere useful to put all those games.

item.title: 'Avatar: Seven Havens' Producers Provide a Suspicious Answer About the Anomaly
item.description: Ever since a mysterious diamond-shaped entity rose out of the ground in one of the Avatar: Seven Havens trailers, curious fans have pointed out how much it resembles Vaatu , the spirit of darkness and chaos at the heart of the Avatar franchise ’s cosmology.

item.title: Sid Meier's Civilization games: the oral history
item.description: Sid Meier (Creator of Civilization, co-founder of MicroProse and Firaxis): I was always playing with toys as a child. I remember spreading my blocks and soldiers and ships over the living room floor until my mom said, “Somebody’s coming over — you gotta clean up!” And I had an interest in history; I read about airplanes and ships, pirates, for example. As I got a little older, I got into board games and strategy games. This was all before computers appeared. When computers appeared, my first computer was the Atari 800. Whoa, I can make my own game s. That was super cool.

item.title: BioWare Deserved Better
item.description: EA shut down BioWare and laid off its remaining employees, ending the Mass Effect studio's three-decade run as the premiere RPG developer.
item.dc:creator: Austin Manchester

item.title: Jenna Ortega's New Sci-Fi Movie Turns Compelling AI Drama Into One Big Joke
item.description: Maybe it’s a sign of a more jaded world or a less capable film , but with Klara and the Sun , I found myself wishing for restraint. Don’t make the obvious joke; don’t encourage another weird face-off between actors. A dramatic scene depicting a robot’s devotion to humanity would land better if we could sit with it without a giggle break. But no such luck.

item.title: Lego Confirms Incredible Daft Punk Set for Official Release
item.description: Lego is officially teaming up with Daft Punk for new "products, content and brand experiences," the toymaker announced Thursday. While Daft Punk (the musical act) split up in 2021, Daft Punk (the brand and trademark) lives on. As part of a new partnership between The Lego Group and the French electronic music duo, a Daft Punk Lego set originally designed by a fan will be released as an official product. But that's apparently just the start of what the brands have in store.
